entries.name: Levy Pikes

ability.name: Brace
ability.desc: Plant the butts: reaction strikes against horse hit twice as hard, but the unit cannot move.

entries.desc: Cheap hedge of ash poles. Holds a line against horse; folds against arrows.

entries.name: Bowmen

ability.name: Volley
ability.desc: Rain arrows on a target; neighbours of the target take half.

entries.desc: Short bows in massed ranks. Punish infantry and pikes that cannot close the distance.

entries.name: Swordhands

ability.name: Shield Bash
ability.desc: A shoving blow; the target hits weaker on its next turn.

entries.desc: Mailed foot with a good blade. The backbone of any line, and the line Resonant Forging improves.

entries.name: Javelineers

ability.name: Hamstring
ability.desc: A low throw that slows the target for two turns.

entries.desc: Quick light throwers that ignore zones of control. Poor against armour, fine against archers and engines.

entries.name: Outriders

ability.name: Hit and Fade
ability.desc: After striking, gain three more steps to withdraw.

entries.desc: Light horse. Run down archers and skirmishers; do not charge a braced pike.

entries.name: Field Rams

ability.name: Shatter
ability.desc: A full swing of the ram. Walls take extra damage.

entries.desc: Roofed timber and iron. Slow, fragile outside a siege, decisive against walls.

entries.name: Field Surgeons

ability.name: Tend
ability.desc: Stitch and salt a wound: heal an ally within two cells.

entries.desc: Salt, thread and steady hands. Heals neighbours a little every turn.

entries.name: Standard Bearers

ability.name: Rally
ability.desc: Lift the morale of every ally within three cells and bring routers back.

entries.desc: A painted cloth on a pole. Units near a living banner lose morale more slowly.

entries.name: Ridge Lancers

ability.name: Lance Rush
ability.desc: A thundering strike. Needs a run-up to carry its full weight.

entries.desc: Karrow's heavy horse from the ridge stables. The hardest charge on the map.

entries.name: Brand-Sworn

ability.name: Red Oath
ability.desc: Fight with the oath on: hit harder, guard less, for three turns.

entries.desc: Veterans who burn a scar for every campaign. Fiercer when wounded.

entries.name: Horn Bearers

ability.name: War Horn
ability.desc: A long note: allies within four cells recover nerve and hit harder for two turns.

entries.desc: A brass horn heard across a valley. Karrow marches to it.

entries.name: Bonebreakers

ability.name: Shatter
ability.desc: A counterweight throw that cracks stone.

entries.desc: Karrow's counterweight engines. Throws from four cells.

entries.name: Salt Crossbows

ability.name: Salted Bolt
ability.desc: A brine-dipped bolt that stings and slows the target.

entries.desc: Saline's pay-by-the-bolt company. Slows what it shoots.

entries.name: Tide Runners

ability.name: Slip Away
ability.desc: After throwing, slide three more cells out of reach.

entries.desc: Harbour scouts who never fight where they are expected.

entries.name: Brine Surgeons

ability.name: Brine Wash
ability.desc: Clean a wound with strong brine: heal and remove slow.

entries.desc: Cheaper than a field surgeon and nearly as good. Saline has a lot of brine.

entries.name: Harbour Ballistae

ability.name: Bolt Storm
ability.desc: Loose the whole rack at once.

entries.desc: Long-armed throwing engines salvaged from dock cranes.

entries.name: Oathpikes

ability.name: Brace
ability.desc: Plant the butts: reaction strikes hit twice as hard, but the unit cannot move.

entries.desc: Ostrel swears its pikemen to a post. They do not run.

entries.name: Ward Shields

ability.name: Shield Wall
ability.desc: Neighbouring allies gain armour for a turn.

entries.desc: Tower shields lashed edge to edge. Slow, hard to move, impossible to ignore.

entries.name: Ink Chaplains

ability.name: Vigil
ability.desc: A recited line: heal an ally and steady its nerve.

entries.desc: Scribes who read the day's casualty list aloud over the wounded.

entries.name: Beacon Standards

ability.name: Hold Fast
ability.desc: Allies in three cells recover nerve and gain armour for two turns.

entries.desc: A fixed lamp on a pole, lit on the day the oath was sworn.

entries.name: Stonethrowers

ability.name: Shatter
ability.desc: Quarried boulders from a heavy arm.

entries.desc: Sturdy engines that also serve on Ostrel's own walls.

entries.name: Quillshots

ability.name: Overwrite
ability.desc: A bolt that marks the target: it takes extra damage for two turns.

entries.desc: The longest bows on the map, fletched with ledger paper.

entries.name: Marginal Riders

ability.name: Dash
ability.desc: Strike, then slip three more cells away.

entries.desc: Couriers turned lancers. They ride the margins and hit the unguarded side.

entries.name: Glossators

ability.name: Erase
ability.desc: Strike a line from an enemy's record: it loses its buffs and morale.

entries.desc: Annotators who mend the wounded in the margin and unmake the enemy's boasts.

entries.name: Lens Arrays

ability.name: Focus
ability.desc: Gather the day into a single burning line.

entries.desc: Ground glass in a timber frame. Burns what other engines only dent.
